dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and smooth 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the visible posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins exhibit a smooth, continuous curve with no detectable bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium grey tone across the visible dorsal area, excluding specular highlights.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse light-grey mottling concentrated on the left-central dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary grey baseline and the lighter mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of several small, high-contrast white punctate marks scattered across the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, scattered light-colored epidermal marks of undetermined origin on the dorsal plane.
